# 3Shamrocks Studio

> Brand and product design studio of Dave Markovich, Product Design Director since 2007, based in Modi'in, Israel. Brand, interface and working app, built in weeks. A fractional Head of Design for startups that just raised.

- 20+ years in product design, 10+ years in HealthTech.
- HealthTech work includes the VIBRANT app for the VIBRANT capsule (the capsule was named one of TIME's 2023 Best Inventions); app users reordered refills twice as often (68% vs 34%, ACG 2024). Also brand and product marketing at AposHealth.
- Contact: dave@3shamrocks.com

## Services
- [AI-Ready Brand Sprint](https://3shamrocks.com/sprint/): 7 working days. Brand audit, refined identity, colour/type token system, an AI rulebook that keeps Claude and Figma on brand, and 20 launch assets. English and Hebrew.

## What Dave does, in the words people search for
- Fractional Head of Design in Israel for seed and Series A startups: one person who owns brand, product design and the working app.
- Product and brand designer who builds working apps with AI (not only Figma screens): design, front end and launch, in weeks.
- Works in English and Hebrew. Based in Modi'in, Israel. Remote or on site in central Israel.

## Products Dave designed and built himself
- [SH✡MER](https://www.shomer-app.co.il/): free Israeli personal and community safety app (one-press SOS, live location, guardian circles), plus SH✡MER Command, a real-time operational board for local authorities and councils.

## בעברית
דייב מרקוביץ', מנהל עיצוב מוצר (Product Design Director) מאז 2007, מודיעין. מעצב מותג ומוצר שבונה אפליקציות עובדות עם AI, ו-Head of Design במשרה חלקית לסטארטאפים אחרי גיוס. בנה בעצמו את SH✡MER, אפליקציית ביטחון אישי וקהילתי, ואת SH✡MER Command למועצות.
